youtube.title: 🔥 This Free AI Gateway Saves You $100s/Month

That adds up to 1.6 billion free tokens per month aggregated across providers. No more surprise bills, no more hitting rate limits mid-project. Just point your IDE at one endpoint and let OmniRoute handle the rest. Search OmniRoute on GitHub to get started with zero dollars and never burn unused quota again.

linkedin.text:
Every month you pay for AI quota that expires unused.

You hit rate limits mid-coding session. You juggle 10 dashboards. And you still end up paying $20–$50 per provider just to keep working.

🚨 That workflow is bleeding money.

OmniRoute fixes it. It's a free AI gateway that connects every coding tool you use—Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Copilot—to 250 AI providers through one endpoint.

✅ 90+ providers with free tiers—11 free forever
✅ Auto-failover in milliseconds when you hit a limit
✅ Up to 95% token savings with built-in compression

You get 1.6 billion free tokens per month aggregated across all providers. 🛠️

Next time you're about to pay for Claude or GPT quota, route through OmniRoute instead. You'll never hit a rate limit or burn unused quota again.

⭐ 2,300+ GitHub stars prove developers are already saving hundreds.

Search "OmniRoute" on GitHub and see the setup guide.

Have you tried auto-routing across free AI tiers yet?
